_comment: Talking to people, when the player's AI is on (docs/ai-integration.md, "Talking to people"). Three kinds of line:
chat.fact.*, chat.deal.*: the fact sheet the AI is given with every turn, the only facts it may use. Written to the
AI, not to the player; one fact a line. {price:money} and the like are filled as everywhere.
chat.stage.*: what happens, sent as the player's turn in [brackets] (the AI answers it): {thing} is what is talked about.
chat.ui.*: the words of the talk window and panel.
chat.offer_words: words that make a number in what the player types an offer (with a currency sign or k it is one anyway).
chat.place.*: where the talk is, for the prompt's {place}. chat.sex.*: {sex}.
rival_car, rival_grudge: {car}. races: {count}, {won} (by the person), {lost}. race_won, race_lost: {when}, {kind}, {pink}.
said_line: {text}. price, price_down: {price}, {asked}. chat.deal.*: {offer}, {price}. today: {date}. player: {player},

lines.chat.place.phone: You are on the telephone at home: the player has called about your ad in the paper.
lines.chat.place.lot: You are on your car lot, where you sell cars; the player is a customer walking round it.
lines.chat.place.curb: You are at the curb in front of your house, where the car stands; the player has come to see it.
lines.chat.place.diner: You are at the diner, where the street racers meet; the player has come over to your table.
lines.chat.place.cruise: You are in your car on the street at night, pulled up beside the player's car, engines running.
lines.chat.stage.phone: [Your telephone rings at home. You pick up; the caller is asking about the {thing} you advertised. Answer the phone as yourself.]
lines.chat.stage.lot: [A customer walks onto your lot. Go over, welcome them, and talk up what you have on the lot.]
lines.chat.stage.lot_car: [A customer walks onto your lot and stops at the {thing}. Go over and start selling it.]
lines.chat.stage.curb: [The player has come round to your place to look at the {thing}. You come out to meet them.]
lines.chat.stage.diner: [The player comes over to your table at the diner.]
lines.chat.stage.cruise: [You have pulled up beside the player's car. They lean out of the window to talk.]
lines.chat.stage.picked: [The customer goes over to the {thing} and looks it over. Go on about it, without being asked.]
lines.chat.stage.picked_again: [The customer comes back to the {thing}, which you already talked about. Say something new about it, not what you said before.]
lines.chat.fact.player: The one you are talking to is {player}, a street racer in town ({wins} wins, {losses} losses, reputation {reputation} of 100).
lines.chat.fact.car_modified: It has been worked on: not as it left the factory.
lines.chat.fact.car_original: It is as it left the factory, nothing changed.
lines.chat.fact.ad: The ad in the paper says: {ad}
lines.chat.fact.on_sale: It has been for sale {days} days.
lines.chat.fact.lot: On your lot ({count} cars), the dearest first:
lines.chat.fact.lot_empty: Your lot is empty right now.
lines.chat.fact.rival: You are {name} "{nickname}", {age}, a street racer: {wins} wins, {losses} losses, reputation {reputation} of 100.
lines.chat.fact.rival_king: You are the King of the street: the one everybody wants to beat.
lines.chat.fact.rival_grudge: The player won your {car} from you on pink slips. You want it back: you want a rematch.
lines.chat.fact.rival_broke: You are broke right now and need money.
lines.chat.fact.no_races: You have never raced the player.
lines.chat.fact.races: You have raced the player {count} times: you won {won}, the player won {lost}. The latest:
lines.chat.fact.no_memories: You do not remember ever talking to the player (you never did, or you have forgotten).
lines.chat.fact.memories: What you remember of talking to the player before:
lines.chat.fact.said: What you already said about this one (do not say it again; say something new):
lines.chat.fact.price: The price is {price:money}. Never name a lower price yourself: only the deal lines below change it.
lines.chat.fact.price_down: You first asked {asked:money}; you have come down to {price:money}. Never name a lower price yourself: only the deal lines below change it.
lines.chat.deal.accept: The player has just offered {offer:money}. You take it: the price is now {price:money}. Say yes, it's a deal.
lines.chat.deal.accept_asked: The player has just offered {offer:money}, more than you ask. You take the price, {price:money}: say it's a deal at that.
lines.chat.deal.counter: The player has just offered {offer:money}. Too low, but you come down to {price:money} and no lower right now. Say so.
lines.chat.deal.firm: The player has just offered {offer:money}. You will not come down any more from {price:money}. Say so.
lines.chat.deal.insulted: The player has just offered {offer:money}: far too low, near an insult. Turn it down; the price stays {price:money}.
lines.chat.ui.hint: Ask about it, or name your price...
lines.chat.ui.dead_line: The line went dead. Try again.
